policy: Owner policy of 28 Jul 2026: no Israeli-domiciled or Israeli-founded companies. scripts/universe_maintenance.py already refuses any candidate whose ISIN starts with IL or whose EODHD fundamentals put the country or the headquarters in Israel. This list is the second line for the companies those data checks can miss: Delaware or Guernsey incorporations, US-ISIN ADRs and US-headquartered companies founded in Israel. Entries marked conservative are excluded because their founders and main R&D centre are in Israel; remove a line to allow automatic addition. The list only blocks automatic additions to Global_Markets; it never removes a row from any page.
